;Armed conflict and attacks
*[[May 2019 Kathmandu bombings]]
**Four people are killed and seven others are injured in three blasts in the city of [[Kathmandu]], [[Nepal]]. [[Nepal Police|Police]] believe a [[Maoist]] [[splinter group]] may have been responsible. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nepal-blasts/four-killed-seven-injured-in-three-explosions-in-nepali-capital-police-idUSKCN1SW0EN?il=0 (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-48415620 (BBC News)]
*[[Iraqi insurgency (2017–present)]]
**Iraq sentences three [[France|French]] militants to death for their involvement in [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIS]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-48414670 (BBC News)]
**A [[Car bomb|truck bomb]] explodes at a popular market in the village of [[Nineveh]], [[Iraq]], killing 5 and injuring 8. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-05/26/c_138091737.htm (Xinhuanet)]
*[[Boko Haram]]
**Four soldiers of the [[Chadian Army]] and a journalist are killed following a [[Boko Haram]] attack near the northern shore of [[Lake Chad]]. Boko Haram have reportedly continued their incursion into northern [[Chad]]. [https://www.africanews.com/2019/05/26/five-dead-in-boko-haram-attack-on-chadian-army-base/ (Africanews)]
*Four people are killed in an attack on a [[Catholic church]] in northern [[Burkina Faso]], the latest in a string of assaults on Christian places of worship in the region. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/05/killed-church-attack-burkina-faso-190526192956228.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Business and economy
*The initial stage of [[Sydney Metro]], [[Australia]]'s first [[Automatic train operation|automated]] [[rapid transit]] system, opens to the public. [https://www.smh.com.au/national/nsw/sydney-commuters-to-hop-aboard-high-tech-railway-future-20190524-p51qpg.html (''The Sydney Morning Herald'')]
*[[Teva Pharmaceutical Industries]] announces, two days before their scheduled trial, it has agreed to pay  $85 million to the U.S. state of [[Oklahoma]]  in connection with allegations that it helped fuel the [[Opioid epidemic in the United States|U.S. opioid epidemic]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-opioids-litigation-oklahoma/teva-pharm-to-pay-oklahoma-85-million-to-settle-opioid-claims-idUSKCN1SW0MS (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Peru earthquake]]
**A strong earthquake measuring {{M|w|link=y}} 8.0 strikes northeastern Peru, causing one death and several injuries. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/05/26/americas/peru-earthquake-may-intl/index.html (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 European Parliament election]]
**In the final stage of the latest European Parliament election, voters in [[2019 European Parliament election in Austria|Austria]], [[2019 European Parliament election in Bulgaria|Bulgaria]], [[2019 European Parliament election in Belgium|Belgium]], [[2019 European Parliament election in Croatia|Croatia]], [[2019 European Parliament election in Cyprus|Cyprus]], [[2019 European Parliament election in Denmark|Denmark]], [[2019 European Parliament election in Estonia|Estonia]], [[2019 European Parliament election in Finland|Finland]], [[2019 European Parliament election in France|Metropolitan France]], [[2019 European Parliament election in Germany|Germany]], [[2019 European Parliament election in Greece|Greece]], [[2019 European Parliament election in Hungary|Hungary]], [[2019 European Parliament election in Italy|Italy]], [[2019 European Parliament election in Lithuania|Lithuania]], [[2019 European Parliament election in Luxembourg|Luxembourg]], [[2019 European Parliament election in Poland|Poland]], [[2019 European Parliament election in Portugal|Portugal]], [[2019 European Parliament election in Romania|Romania]], [[2019 European Parliament election in Slovenia|Slovenia]], [[2019 European Parliament election in Spain|Spain]], and [[2019 European Parliament election in Sweden|Sweden]] elect their country's representatives. [http://www.europarl.europa.eu/at-your-service/en/be-heard/elections (European Parliament)]
*[[2019 Belgian federal election]]
**In addition to the [[European Parliament]] and [[2019 Belgian regional elections|regional]] elections, voters in [[Belgium]] head to the polls to vote for the members of the [[Chamber of Representatives (Belgium)|Chamber of Representatives]]. [https://www.euronews.com/2019/05/25/eu-elections-2019-country-by-country-guide-on-what-to-look-out-for (Euronews)]
*[[2019 Lithuanian presidential election]]
** [[Lithuania]]n citizens also are heading to the polls to elect their future president in the second round of the latest presidential election. [https://www.politico.eu/article/close-race-ahead-in-lithuanias-presidential-election/ (Politico)]
*[[Papua New Guinea]]'s Prime Minister [[Peter O'Neill]] announces his resignation over disputes of him holding dual citizenship and after weeks of defections from his coalition government. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/390596/png-s-pm-announces-resignation-and-handover (Radio New Zealand)]
*[[2019 Greek legislative election]]
**[[Prime Minister of Greece|Greek Prime Minister]] [[Alexis Tsipras]], whose term expires in October, calls for snap elections following his leftist [[Syriza]] party's heavy defeat by the opposition conservatives in the European Parliament elections. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-eu-election-greece-exit-poll/greek-pm-calls-snap-vote-after-drubbing-for-ruling-syriza-idUSKCN1SW0MO?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Sports
*[[2019 IndyCar Series]]
**2016 IndyCar Series champion [[Simon Pagenaud]] of France wins the 103rd running of the [[2019 Indianapolis 500|Indianapolis 500]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/simon-pagenaud-wins-indianapolis-500-alexander-rossi-103rd-running-indycar-indianapolis-motor-today-2019-05-26/ (CBS News)]
*[[2019 IIHF World Championship|2019 IIHF Ice Hockey World Championship]]
**[[Finland]] defeats [[Canada]] to win gold medal at Ice Hockey World Championship in [[Slovakia]]. [https://yle.fi/uutiset/osasto/news/finlands_lions_claim_ice_hockey_world_championship/10802862 (Yle News)]
